brief: Compare final purchase costs after a stated discount and mandatory fee, using the same item and payment conditions.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Compare the final price"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Compara el precio final"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Compare o preço final"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare final purchase costs after a stated discount and mandatory fee, using the same item and payment conditions.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A large discount can still leave a higher final price. Compare what you actually have to pay.
instruction.misconception: Choosing the biggest discount percentage while ignoring the original price or a mandatory delivery charge.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked example calculates the percentage reduction, subtracts it, then adds the stated fee.

evidence.reasoning: A price of 100 with 20% off removes 20, leaving 80. A required delivery charge of 10 makes 90 total.
The same item costs 85 elsewhere with delivery included. Its final price is lower, despite having no discount label.
The total includes both the item and required delivery.
The identical item and included delivery make the totals comparable.
The discount amount is removed from the original price.
The larger discount label does not guarantee the lower final price.
A missing mandatory cost prevents a complete comparison.
The full cost, including required fees, determines whether it fits.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Apply this skill in a later integrated decision with a different constraint.
